description:
Native Android client for Nginx Proxy Manager: hosts, SSL, access lists, users NPM Mobile manages your Nginx Proxy Manager (NPM) server from your phone. It is a native app, not a web wrapper: it talks directly to your server's API, with no cloud service in between and no tracking. Features
  • Dashboard: host counts, NPM update notice, and a list of problems (hosts whose nginx config failed, certificates expiring soon)
  • Proxy hosts: create, edit, enable/disable and delete; domains, forward scheme/host/port, caching, exploit blocking, websockets, access lists, custom locations, SSL (force SSL, HTTP/2, HSTS) and custom nginx configuration
  • Redirection hosts, streams (TCP/UDP) and 404 hosts
  • SSL certificates: request Let's Encrypt certificates (HTTP or DNS challenge with any provider NPM supports), test domain reachability, renew, download, delete, and upload custom certificates with validation
  • Access lists: basic-auth users and allow/deny IP rules
  • Users (admins): accounts, roles, per-section permissions and passwords
  • Audit log and the default site setting
  • Your account: profile, password, and two-factor authentication (QR code setup, backup codes); 2FA sign-in is supported
  • Several NPM servers, automatic session renewal, light/dark theme and Material You colors
Session tokens are stored encrypted with a key from the Android Keystore. Plain HTTP is allowed for LAN addresses (NPM's admin UI usually runs on port 81); for HTTP to a public address the app warns you first. Tested with Nginx Proxy Manager 2.15. This is an unofficial app, not affiliated with the Nginx Proxy Manager project.
